# Readability test data

The data comes from the `testdata` folder of [prose at `b33e60d`][prose], which Vale counts with, under the MIT license in [`data/readability/prose.LICENSE`](../../../data/readability/prose.LICENSE).  

- [`syllables.tsv`](syllables.tsv) holds the 4,383 words and syllable counts of `syllables.json`, one row each.
- [`scores.tsv`](scores.tsv) holds the counts and scores of the three cases of `summarize.json`, to two decimals.  
  Each text is in `scores-<n>.txt.fixture`.

[prose]: https://github.com/jdkato/prose/tree/b33e60d/testdata
